stem: Which of these best states the author's claim about citing sources?

options.label: A
options.text: People have a moral obligation to cite sources.

options.label: B
options.text: People produce better writing when they cite sources.

options.label: C
options.text: There is much debate about how people should cite sources.

options.label: D
options.text: It is challenging for most people to properly cite sources.
